text: ok i can open and close them still like before. i cant go thru them. i can in the test route. i cant in the compiled route. so if the test says the compiled game can go through an open door its not true
resolution: You were right on both counts. (1) There was no test that walked a body through an open door in the compiled path — the prior 'proof' was a boot/render proof and a by-construction argument. Now it is stepped for real: zig build test-game-physics packs the exact rect floats world_loader.zig writes for a door leaf and runs the body at the doorway through framework/game/physics.zig — closed blocks at the panel face, open(parked) walks clean through, and a canary pins the req_0663 bug (a de-flagged non-solid 2.2m rect STILL blocks, the walkable-platform side-push law). All green at 89c60847d. (2) Why you still could not walk through: the /compiled route is the WorldLoader primitive INSIDE the editor host binary — the Compile button re-bakes data only; the open-door fix (e3dde777f, park the rect instead of de-flagging) is a Zig change and only reaches you when the editor binary itself is rebuilt. Your binary has the doors slice (you can see/toggle them) but predates the park fix, which reproduces 'still like before' exactly. Rebuild the editor host, then Compile and load in.
